ACTS.teaches: the ship: moving in the box, the two reticles, the barrel roll
the gun, and the lock-on sweep (a school is eight in a line)
the forms: shots of your feeling are drunk, the other one hurts
the parry: darters spit outlined shots at the camera; a roll in time sends them home
the sea itself: flotsam to gather, the reckoning's marks, a breath
nothing: the tally, and the island in sight

beats.does: the crude boils under the ship: the shoal rises and balls round you, tightening a bar at a time
the ball strikes in pulses from every side; its caller glows: down the caller and the shoal scatters
what the shoal was running from: the heavy and its escort (the authored waves)
a brig astern, closing; its bow chasers lob outlined shot: parry it back into her bow
alongside: the gunports open a bar before each volley; boarders swing across; cut the rigging with a full lock
crippled or not, she comes about to ram: hole her hull or out-run her
she strikes her colours or limps off; what she carried floats astern
the sea heaves; it breaches across the rail ahead: roll through the spray
it runs alongside: four gills glow; its fins sweep (roll), it spits outlined globs (parry them into the gills)
it sounds: its shadow grows under the ship; be out of the ring when it breaches
face to face, the maw open: lock its teeth, parry its spit down its throat; at bar 96 it dives away or is felled
